Review.title: Review
Review.description: Public customer review displayed on the Sufrah Ravi website without exposing customer email.

verified.description: Whether the review is verified by email submission

isPublic.description: Flag indicating the review is public for listing

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the review was submitted

ReviewPrivate.title: ReviewPrivate
ReviewPrivate.description: Isolated private record storing the reviewer's required email address (never publicly readable).

reviewId.description: ID of the corresponding public review document

email.description: Reviewer's required email address kept private

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the private record was created

Order.title: Order
Order.description: Customer order record for Order History and easy reordering (PII isolated in OrderPrivate).

userId.description: Identifier of the customer who placed the order

itemCodes.description: Bounded list (max 20) of encoded order line items (menuItemId|quantity|selectedSpice|note)

isPublicOrder.description: Query enforcer flag for listing orders

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the order was placed

OrderPrivate.title: OrderPrivate
OrderPrivate.description: Isolated private record storing customer phone and delivery address for an order.

orderId.description: ID of the corresponding order document

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the private order record was created

UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: User authentication record storing display name and SHA-256 salted password hash (raw email isolated in UserPrivate).

accountId.description: Deterministic SHA-256 identifier derived from normalized email

passwordHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of salted password

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the account was registered

UserPrivate.title: UserPrivate
UserPrivate.description: Isolated private record storing the registered user's email address.

email.description: Registered user email address kept private

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the private user record was created

/reviews/{reviewId}.description: Public customer reviews collection (no PII/email stored here).

/review_private/{reviewId}.description: Private collection storing the customer's email address required for review submission.

/orders/{orderId}.description: Customer orders collection for Order History and one-click reordering (no phone/address PII stored here).

/order_private/{orderId}.description: Private collection storing the customer's phone number and delivery address for an order.

/user_accounts/{accountId}.description: User accounts collection for password verification (no raw email PII, no list queries allowed).

/user_private/{accountId}.description: Private collection storing the registered user's email address.
